source_review: Existing loader whole-image/signing normalization and one-attempt dlopen reused; same verified local byte snapshot feeds binding, without a duplicate retained image or alternate validation path.
Integrated branch verifies actual loaded HTTP ABI before invoking native configuration getter. Diagnostic original loader entry remains unchanged.

Bounded Mach-O/LC_FUNCTION_STARTS metadata parser requires unique exact80B getter/504B constructor body hashes and the actual getter BL relation; source source-memory metadata contains191463 starts all inside text, final body20 bytes.
Runtime unique image path/header/base/slide and dladdr checks plus safe code snapshots revalidate exact getter/constructor identities before calling the no-argument getter serially on main.

Only source-proved host descriptor and port fields are copied from native configuration. Every native pointer read uses bounded vm_read_overwrite (mach/mach.h, compile-time native pointer/size width checks) with checked failure, not unchecked dereference. Descriptor/port are rechecked around the snapshot.
Capability has unavailable public initializer/read-only URL and main-only current validation against exact loaded image/config object/current origin. No URL is printed or saved.

Integrated host starts Foundation deny-all before dlopen, then binds actual capability/routes through one-use native rearm before image attachment/AppDelegate. Diagnostic never requests or arms the native origin.
Transport peer owns same-queue rearm, initial strict deny-all requirement, HTTP/capability preflight and old-configuration identity invalidation.
A later changed native origin does not authorize a new origin; unsupported requests remain local errors, never remote fallback.
limits: Source review and static metadata only. Actual runtime function calls, origin serialization, cold initialization and rearm have not run.
Existing Foundation coverage does not prove global initializer/system/SDK/raw-socket/WebKit isolation.
Source-specific string ABI applies only to the exact admitted engine. The helper does not assume a future SDK/libc++ layout.
Real integrated factory/async preparation, actual master acceptance, first login/home/gameplay and physical Duo verification are still pending.
